posts.name: Aniruddh S
posts.cooked:
I hope this message finds you well.
I am writing to inquire about my BPT1 results for the System Commands course. I had applied for Re-OPPE, and despite having attended and passed 3 out of 4 questions, I am unable to view my BPT1 result in my Course Dashboard.

I would appreciate your assistance in resolving this issue at the earliest.

Looking forward to your response.
Roll No: 23F1001599
@sayan @Subendu

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Dear Students,

For Repeat OPPE students

  • BPT is required for eligibility for OPPE
  • However BPT marks is taken from last term
  • It will not show up in portal, no need to worry

Regards,
Course Team
System Commands

posts.name: M H Ananta sri
posts.cooked: I’ve opted for repeat OPPE alone for system commands in this term. I have not received the marks for the first 2 BPTs till now.

posts.name: Puja Ghosh
posts.cooked: for repeat OPPE, the previous marks will be considered even though BPTs are necessary to attend OPPE. They have stored the previous marks and will award final grade based on that.

posts.name: Puneet
posts.cooked: Adding to the @Puja 's point. But still you need to submit the BPTs on time for getting eligible for giving the OPPE exam. Therefore, please submit all the BPTs before the deadline.
